_comment: The facts block synthesis writes when only a table nothing writes has a CDC copy (#2459). tests/unit/report/test_sources_of_truth_section.py checks it still matches; components/__tests__/TableOwnersCallout.test.js checks the results page prints its sentence.

table_sources.shared_risk_sentence: Every table another engine reads through CDC has this risk. Eventually consistent: a read on a replica reads a copy kept current from the table's owner (its source of truth) via CDC, so it sees a write only after CDC applies it, behind by the replication lag; a read that must see its own write should read from the owner.
